LOC_ECONOMICS_MOD_DESCRIPTION: Borrow from other civilizations or a bond market and pay it back from what the Gold brings in, lend to a neighbour in trouble, pick a tax level as a policy card, and watch an auto-loan guard keep you clear of the game's negative-balance penalties. Missed payments cost you, default costs more, and repudiating a debt keeps the Gold at the price of your name. Single-player.
LOC_ECONOMICS_SETUP_LOANS_DESCRIPTION: Whether civilizations can borrow from each other and, later, from a bond market, within a limit set by income. Off turns the loans off; trade bills and investment keep their own options.
LOC_ECONOMICS_SETUP_LOANS_OFF_DESCRIPTIO: Nobody borrows or lends, and the guard stays out.
LOC_ECONOMICS_SETUP_LOANS_ON_DESCRIPTION: Loans between civilizations open with Moneylending, the bond market with Public debt.
LOC_ECONOMICS_SETUP_GUARD_DESCRIPTION: When your treasury is about to fall below the line where the game starts taking amenities, the guard takes out an emergency loan for you, up to a cap of ten turns of your income. You can also switch it on the Loans tab.
LOC_ECONOMICS_SETUP_GUARD_OFF_DESCRIPTIO: You borrow only when you ask to. The game's penalties for a negative balance apply as usual.
LOC_ECONOMICS_SETUP_GUARD_ON_DESCRIPTION: An emergency loan covers a shortfall before the game's penalties start, until the cap is reached. You're told once when it is.
LOC_ECONOMICS_SETUP_AI_DESCRIPTION: Whether the computer players take part: borrowing when they run short, lending when they're flush, restructuring an overdue loan, and now and then repudiating a debt to an enemy.
LOC_ECONOMICS_SETUP_AI_OFF_DESCRIPTION: Only you borrow and lend. The computer players keep their treasuries as the base game runs them.
LOC_ECONOMICS_SETUP_AI_ON_DESCRIPTION: Computer players borrow, lend, restructure and repudiate by the same rules you play under.
LOC_ECONOMICS_SETUP_RATES_DESCRIPTION: Scales every interest rate in the game, the rate cap included. Standard is 3 percent a turn in Antiquity, 2 in Exploration and 1.5 in Modern before standing and relationship adjust it.
LOC_ECONOMICS_SETUP_RATES_LOW_DESCRIPTIO: Three quarters of the standard rates. Borrowing is cheap and lending pays less.
LOC_ECONOMICS_SETUP_RATES_STANDARD_DESCR: The rates the mod is balanced around.
LOC_ECONOMICS_SETUP_RATES_HIGH_DESCRIPTI: A quarter above the standard rates. Debt bites sooner and lending pays more.
LOC_ECONOMICS_SETUP_TAXES_DESCRIPTION: Adds the tax policy cards: Light Taxation, Heavy Taxation and War Levy. Each trades Gold against happiness in one of your ordinary policy slots, and the computer players choose among them as they do any card.
LOC_ECONOMICS_SETUP_TAXES_OFF_DESCRIPTIO: The tax cards aren't in the game.
LOC_ECONOMICS_SETUP_TAXES_ON_DESCRIPTION: The three tax cards appear in the policy list as their civics unlock them.
LOC_ECONOMICS_SETUP_STAGES_DESCRIPTION: Whether each part opens with the tech or civic that historically brought it in: loans between civilizations with Moneylending, the bond market and longer terms with Public debt.
LOC_ECONOMICS_SETUP_STAGES_OFF_DESCRIPTI: Every part is open from the start of its age.
LOC_ECONOMICS_SETUP_STAGES_ON_DESCRIPTIO: A part opens for a civilization when it reaches the stage's tech or civic. With the option off everything is open from the start of its age.
LOC_ECONOMICS_SETUP_MARKETS_DESCRIPTION: Gives every resource a world price, set by how many copies there are and who needs them. Each pair of civilizations then settles the net value of what they import from each other every turn, on top of the Trade Income the game already pays the exporter. A civilization pays at most a tenth of its income this way.
LOC_ECONOMICS_SETUP_MARKETS_OFF_DESCRIPT: Resources have no price, and a route costs the importer what it does in the base game.
LOC_ECONOMICS_SETUP_MARKETS_ON_DESCRIPTI: Bills open with the Trade stage (Code of Laws in Antiquity) and show on the Trade tab.
LOC_ECONOMICS_SETUP_TARIFFS_DESCRIPTION: Lets a civilization hold back part of what it owes the civilizations it imports from: 10 percent at Low, 25 at High. A High tariff costs relationship with each partner it bills. Needs Markets and trade bills.
LOC_ECONOMICS_SETUP_TARIFFS_OFF_DESCRIPT: Every civilization pays its full bill.
LOC_ECONOMICS_SETUP_TARIFFS_ON_DESCRIPTI: Tariffs open with Imperialism, on the Fiscal tab. The computer players answer a High tariff in kind.
LOC_ECONOMICS_SETUP_INVESTMENT_DESCRIPTI: Lets civilizations put Gold into each other: a development loan on a city's current build, a general investment in its treasury, or either as aid with nothing asked back.
LOC_ECONOMICS_SETUP_INVESTMENT_OFF_DESCR: Each civilization keeps its Gold at home.
LOC_ECONOMICS_SETUP_INVESTMENT_ON_DESCRI: Development loans open with Guild patronage (Guilds), general investment with Chartered companies (Colonialism), and aid is open from the start.
LOC_ECONOMICS_CARD_LIGHT_DESCRIPTION: -2 Gold and +4 Happiness in each settlement.
LOC_ECONOMICS_CARD_HEAVY_DESCRIPTION: +4 Gold and -2 Happiness in each settlement.
LOC_ECONOMICS_CARD_WAR_LEVY_DESCRIPTION: While you're at war: +8 Gold and -4 Happiness in each settlement. In peacetime it doesn't pay or cost anything.
LOC_ECONOMICS_TAX_SLOT_DESCRIPTION: +1 Policy slot, for a tax card or any other.

LOC_ECONOMICS_LEND_RULE: They accept while they're short of Gold, their income is positive and the payments fit their limits. If they default or repudiate, the loss is yours.
LOC_ECONOMICS_RISK_LOW: low. They repudiate a debt to an enemy at war, or to a civilization they dislike while insolvent or in default.
LOC_ECONOMICS_RISK_WAR: high: you're at war with them, and they repudiate debts to enemies.
LOC_ECONOMICS_RISK_INSOLVENT: they've had no income for {1_Turns} turns; they can't take your loan and may repudiate what they owe.
LOC_ECONOMICS_RISK_NO_INCOME: their income is at or below 0, so they won't accept.
LOC_ECONOMICS_RISK_DEFAULT: they're in default on another loan.
LOC_ECONOMICS_RISK_UNFRIENDLY: they dislike you: a debt over {1_Amount} Gold is one they'd repudiate while in trouble.
LOC_ECONOMICS_GUARD_NOTE: The guard borrows for you when your balance would go below 0 while your income is at or below 0, which is when the game disbands units. A dip with positive income costs nothing, so it leaves that alone.
LOC_ECONOMICS_LOANS_PENDING_NOTE: Requests run at the start of the next turn, in this order. The turn's notice says what was refused and why.
